verdict.rationale: Recurring job scheduling is a fair question for an operations and automation platform like PagerDuty, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows event-triggered Incident Workflows (e.g., firing for P1/P2 incidents), on-call people schedules, and a one-off 'Schedule a Scribe Agent' action. None of these is a recurring, time-based job or workflow scheduler. An incident trigger or one-off action is not a recurring schedule, so there is no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
